data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains its subject rather than describing it only if the test is a guard that fires on the author when the subject changes, and the 3-of-26 distribution arises because compile.py lacks such self-firing guards (1/9) while the ordinarily-guarded modules have them installed (4/4 to 6/7).","counterconditions":[{"case":"If a test can constrain its subject without ever having been shown to fail first (e.g., a property-based test that catches an unanticipated mutation), the self-firing requirement is too strong.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 1-of-9 compile.py loss includes mutations that did trigger a shown failure but were not recorded as lost, the distribution would not support the mechanism.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 4/4 to 6/7 losses are due to guard coverage (mutations inside guarded code paths) rather than fail-first installation, the self-firing explanation would be redundant.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If a guard fires on the author during installation but is then weakened to pass, the test reverts to description, contradicting the claim unless weakening is treated as a constraint failure.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"A test that never fires on its author is a description; it becomes a constraint when it is designed so that a mutation in the subject will make the test fail against the author's own installation. Shown-to-fail-first installation is the mechanism that guarantees self-firing: the author first demonstrates the test failing on the unmutated subject, then installs the mutation only if the test no longer fails. In compile.py, the mutations are evaluated before any such self-firing guard is installed, so only 1 of 9 is caught. In modules with ordinarily-guarded tests, the guards have been installed fail-first, so 4/4 to 6/7 mutations are lost.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
